notes: IMDiddyToken is a standard fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 IMDIDDY once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers deliver the exact amount, and the token exposes no additional minting or administrative controls. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs IMDIDDY with IMD on Ethereum mainnet. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, accounting for currency ordering.
